skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals 80% ATK (+10) damage to a single target.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Strikes a single target with a 2-hit combo for 90% ATK (+5) damage, with a 100% chance to inflict [Corrosion] for 2 turns (DMG reduction rate lowered by 30%).

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Strikes a single target with a 2-hit combo for 100% ATK (+5) damage, with a 100% chance to inflict [Corrosion] for 2 turns (DMG reduction rate lowered by 30%).

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP by (+20). While Deep Sea Destroyer is on the field, increases own damage by 20% until the end of battle.

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP by (+20). While Deep Sea Destroyer is on the field, increases own damage by 25% until the end of battle.

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP by (+20). While Deep Sea Destroyer is on the field, increases own damage by 28% until the end of battle.
